title: ask, seek, knock

verses.text: Ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and the door will be opened to you.
For everyone who asks receives; he who seeks finds; and to him who knocks, the door will be opened.
So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!”

caption:
Keep asking. Not because God is reluctant, but because He is a good Father.

Jesus does not describe a door you have to force. He describes a Father who hears the asking and gives the best gift of all, Himself. Keep coming, even when the words run thin.

Matthew 7:7, 7:8 and Luke 11:13 (BSB)

Save this for the day the asking feels pointless. Send it to someone who has been praying a long time.
